verdict.rationale: Stripe documents creating, customizing, and sending Stripe-hosted invoices from the Dashboard with no code, plus invoice branding customization. That covers the core of sending hosted invoices, and a Stripe-hosted invoice implies, without stating, that customers can pay online. Smart Retries only retries failed payments and is not an invoice reminder feature, so automatic reminders have no evidence. missing for 10: explicit evidence that hosted invoices carry an online pay page or payment methods, automatic invoice reminder emails, independent or hands-on corroboration.
